india_trends.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
india_trends.summary: The conference, titled “Financing India’s Journey towards Viksit Bharat”, comes ahead of the 7 October meeting of the GST Council and the formal start of pre-budget meetings for the Union Budget 2027-28 from 12 October.

india_trends.title: Chip stocks surge: Intel jumps 10%; Marvell, AMD and Nvidia extend gains | Key triggers explained
india_trends.summary: Major US chip stocks rallied on September 17, led by Intel's 10% rise to $111. AMD also gained 7% to $547. The recovery follows heavy losses due to AI development concerns, but easing Treasury yields and sustained growth in AI infrastructure have boosted investor sentiment.

india_trends.title: Noel Tata threatens to veto Tata Sons listing, wants three-year window from RBI
india_trends.summary: Noel Tata said Chandrasekaran had assured the board in September 2025 and February 2026 that the company was taking all necessary steps to keep it private. Today's meeting outcome will validate if that statement was sincerely given, he said.

The order is part of expanding railway lines in the Khurda Road Division, to be completed in 1,095 days.

india_trends.title: Insurance stocks gain on expectations of lower distributor commissions
india_trends.summary: Life and general insurance shares gained amid expectations that Irdai could lower commissions paid to distributors, particularly banks, potentially reducing distribution costs.
